class.name: MarkdownView
class.brief_description: Native CommonMark and GitHub Flavored Markdown renderer [Control].
class.description:
Renders CommonMark, GitHub Flavored Markdown (tables, strikethrough, task lists, permissive autolinks), and GitHub/Obsidian callouts ([code]> [!NOTE][/code], [code]> [!TIP][/code], [code]> [!IMPORTANT][/code], [code]> [!WARNING][/code], [code]> [!CAUTION][/code], and custom kinds) directly onto its own canvas via Godot's [TextServer] and [RenderingServer]. The control reports its laid-out document height through [method Control._get_minimum_size], so placing it inside a [ScrollContainer] or [VBoxContainer] with horizontal expand sizing lets it wrap to the available width and grow vertically automatically. When nested inside a [ScrollContainer], primitives outside the visible vertical band are culled automatically. Raw HTML blocks and tags are safely ignored except for [code]
[/code] tags, which are treated as hard line breaks.

method.name: clear_image_cache
method.description: Clears all cached image resolutions (including negative misses) and triggers a layout rebuild so images are resolved again through [member image_resolver] or [code]res://[/code].

method.name: get_plain_text
method.description: Returns the concatenated plain-text representation of the document with Markdown formatting stripped, with logical blocks separated by newlines. Ensures layout is up to date before returning.

method.name: get_task_count
method.description: Returns the total number of GFM task-list items ([code]- [ ][/code] / [code]- [x][/code]) parsed in the current [member markdown] document.

method.name: get_total_character_count
method.description: Returns the total number of countable characters in the laid-out document used for typewriter progression via [member visible_characters] and [member visible_ratio]. Ensures layout is up to date before returning.

method.name: is_task_checked
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the task item at [param task_index] (in document order, zero-based) is currently checked. Returns [code]false[/code] if [param task_index] is out of range.

method.name: set_task_checked
method.description: Programmatically updates the checked state of the task item at [param task_index] and queues a redraw. Does not emit [signal task_toggled] and does nothing if [param task_index] is out of range.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], long lines in code blocks wrap within the available width. If [code]false[/code], overflowing code blocks become horizontally scrollable via click-drag, horizontal mouse wheel, Shift+wheel, or trackpad pan gestures.

Optional [Callable] with signature [code]func(uri: String) -> Texture2D[/code] used to resolve Markdown image URIs. If unset or returning [code]null[/code], URIs starting with [code]res://[/code] are loaded automatically via [ResourceLoader]. Results are cached until [method clear_image_cache] is called or [member image_resolver] is changed.
If [code]true[/code], clicking a task-list checkbox toggles its state, redraws the checkbox, and emits [signal task_toggled]. Also switches the mouse cursor to a pointing hand over checkboxes.
The Markdown source text to parse and render. Setting this property re-parses the document, resets task states to the source document's initial checkmarks, and triggers a layout rebuild.

Optional [MarkdownTheme] resource controlling fonts, colors, spacing, styles, and callouts. When [code]null[/code], an internal dark default theme ([method MarkdownTheme.create_dark]) is used. Changes to the assigned theme automatically trigger re-layout and redraw.

Limits how many characters of the document are drawn for typewriter-style reveals. A value of [code]-1[/code] (or any negative number, normalized to [code]-1[/code]) displays the entire document. Synchronizes [member visible_ratio].

Normalized fraction in [code][0.0, 1.0][/code] of the document to display. Setting this value updates [member visible_characters] proportionally ([code]1.0[/code] sets [member visible_characters] to [code]-1[/code]).

signal.name: layout_updated
signal.description: Emitted whenever the document layout is rebuilt (after changing [member markdown], [member markdown_theme], [member code_block_wrap], [member image_resolver], or resizing the control width).

signal.name: link_clicked
signal.description: Emitted when the user left-clicks a Markdown hyperlink or linked image, passing its decoded destination [param url].

signal.name: link_hovered
signal.description: Emitted when the hovered hyperlink changes. [param url] is the link destination when entering a link, or an empty [String] when leaving all links or exiting the control.

signal.name: task_toggled
signal.description: Emitted when the user clicks a task-list checkbox while [member interactive_tasks] is [code]true[/code], reporting the zero-based [param task_index] and its new [param checked] state.
